I went through four different ones until I met Dr. Francesca. My shepherd loves her too, and now she lets them do everything for her. In addition to their professionalism with our animals, they are experts at managing their owners! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Thanks from all the staff
The service was very good.

This is the second time I've brought my dog. First and foremost, the friendliness of the reception staff. The doctor was smiling and friendly (not something you'd expect). He seemed thorough, which is a good thing in these cases. The cost of the services and the quality of the service were excellent, considering my dog ​​spent two days in day hospital. I can confidently give it 5 stars.

I landed at this clinic after my long-time vet moved to another city... I have two ugly, hysterical Chihuahuas 🤣.. well, they went to see Dr. Petrella without batting an eyelid... A near miracle 🙏.. both empathetic, friendly, super professional, ALWAYS available on the phone, and above all (which isn't easy to find) they speak our language, they explain things to you in such a way that we, the owners, can clearly understand the diagnoses, tests, treatments... I had a great time... super super recommended

Dr. Giorgia Baldassarra is amazing. She performed a small miracle on my sixteen-year-old dog. With laser therapy, acupuncture, exercises, and massage, my little girl is now doing great. All with so much love. Thank you so much.
Friendly and helpful staff. Reservations required.

I drive over an hour just for a vaccination because they're the best. The staff are kind and knowledgeable, they work with all breeds and know how to treat my Czechoslovakian. Fair prices. Highly recommended!
Thank you

I couldn't ask for a better place to care for my animals! My trusted veterinary clinic has become a second home for me and my four-legged friends, and the beating heart of it all is undoubtedly *Dr. Damia*, whom I deeply love for her professionalism, kindness, and extraordinary humanity.

Every visit is a moment of true care, based not only on medical expertise, but also on listening, attention, and respect. Dr. Damia has a rare gift: she manages to convey calm, trust, and a genuine love for animals that is simply contagious.

The clinic is always clean, welcoming, and perfectly organized. The team is kind, helpful, and ready to welcome you with a smile, but it's *Dr. Damia* who makes everything special. I feel safe with her, knowing my animals are in the best possible hands.

Thank you so much for everything you do every day. I wouldn't change you for the world! 🐶

After years of visits, treatments, and false hopes at various facilities, I can finally say I've found the right clinic for my pets: the Vescovio Veterinary Clinic. Not only are the facilities always spotlessly clean, tidy, and welcoming, but the atmosphere is that of a place where love for animals is genuine.

The doctors' expertise is extraordinary: attentive, meticulous, always up-to-date, and above all, humane. After so much time, it was they who found the right treatment and truly healed my four-legged friends. Every visit was handled with professionalism and great empathy, and I couldn't be more grateful.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants the best for their pets. They deserve every single star! 🐶🐾❤️

I wanted to share my experience with the Vescovio clinic. I have two French bulldogs, a male and a female, and they've been patients of Dr. Damia ever since I got them.
Everything was fine until we decided to have a litter of puppies.
When it came time to give birth, six puppies were born, but unfortunately, one had a serious problem, so we decided to remove it, and they told us it could happen. Okay...
We took the remaining five puppies home. We're not breeders, but private individuals, so we stayed with the vet, who would contact us for any problems or information we needed, to ensure the puppies were raised in optimal health. After about a week, we noticed that one puppy wasn't eating well and wasn't breathing well. A day passed, and since the situation hadn't changed, we immediately called and brought the puppy to the clinic. We kept him under observation for a few hours (not much, in my opinion), and in the early afternoon, they told us we could take him home, saying that she believed he would die soon; there was no hope, and that he had a lung malformation. Unfortunately, the puppy died that evening, and to our distress, we noticed that two others were exhibiting the same symptoms, so out of concern, we texted the vet early the next morning, a message to which we never received a response. Naturally, given the situation, we immediately turned to another clinic, which told us to take all four remaining puppies immediately, diagnosing them as having gained too much weight (the vet had told us how to feed them and how often), and therefore unable to move properly. Their rib cages had become deformed, and as a result, their lungs didn't have enough space for normal breathing. They kept them on oxygen for three days, put them in braces to restore their rib cages (luckily, they were so small and malleable that the situation resolved itself in the best way possible), and fed them regularly. So, I'm grateful for having had the forethought to turn to someone else and for the clinic that took care of them. The puppies are doing well, growing, and looking beautiful.
All this is to highlight the superficiality and lack of competence of a professional who should have supported us step by step, at least until the puppies were weaned, knowing our inexperience in this situation.

Therefore, I would not wish such a traumatic experience on anyone.

Unfortunately, I have to give one star.
Excellent

I've been going to this clinic for years. I hoped, despite the negative feelings, that they would be temporary. After today's experience, I stopped.
When I asked to schedule an appointment for my dog, for an urgent problem—knowing my dog ​​well—I was told over the phone, "There's no room for Saturday." The doctor I spoke to didn't even offer alternatives, nor ask how the dog was doing or if there was anything wrong. I was the one who had to say that I'd prefer to wait until Saturday for a spot. But I was told, "Ma'am, there's no room for Saturday." To which I thanked them and decided to call it a day. I later sent an email reporting this issue, and they responded rudely, showing little empathy or helpfulness, even though they say otherwise. This isn't the first time I've found myself in a situation I don't like with this situation. Another time, I was prescribed a painkiller, medicine for arthritis, because my dog ​​was limping. Two different vets examined him on two different days: one told me it was probably arthritis and prescribed various other medications. A few days later, another vet told me he probably had a hangnail or had stepped on a cigarette, causing him to limp. In short, conflicting opinions and a lot of money, because they're not cheap...
After today's experience, I decided to schedule an appointment with a different vet, where I found great empathy and helpfulness...
I was shocked because they presented the options only after I expressed my disagreement and expressed how much I didn't appreciate the rudeness of the vet who spoke to me. I've never expected immediate availability, also because I'm a very respectful person and know what it's like to be pressed for time, but I can't accept the lack of empathy, initial availability, and rudeness. Full stop. And I will definitely not recommend him to anyone I know.
Thank you….!!!!! Kind regards
Professional
Dr. Damia is a point of reference, confident, professional, extremely competent.
